name: THE BARMAN
note: Errata 326, doc 133 (Tyler, 2026-11-14: "Add a barman"; then, of the first, "This looks awful", and "Can we get a good, new bartender?"). Three lines speak of the Nugget's barman (he pays for the tuning, doc 57 A7; he watches Thad consider the bar, doc 49; he keeps the lamps trimmed) and nobody stood behind the bar. Drawn by the second brief against the drinkers he stands among, with one correction (reference/nugget-barman/handback-2.md). Every colour is the drawing's own: nothing is regraded in the cut. He stands behind the counter between the second and third drinkers, inside the bar's own hotspot. He talks now (errata 331): the piano is his, and he offers two dollars to put it right and pays them across the bar when told (doc 27, THE BARMAN; doc 57 A8). Over him, the pointer finds him, not the bar. No barks and no approach; nothing about him is marked (invariant 9).
walkToNote: Errata 331. He is behind the counter with a drinker either side, so no stand clears everyone. Thad stands at the counter in the gap to his left, side-on and facing him, so the barman is whole. Thad's back edge crosses the blue-shirted drinker (nugget_bar2), part of the painted crowd that tests/staging-clear.test.ts lets him pass in front of. Seen in the build, at half size (renders/room-03-talking-to-the-barman.png). Errata 361 (Tyler, 2026-11-16): "Thad can talk over a drinker to the barman, just like a real bar." The stand stays.
anchorNote: A BAND, like the drinkers: the sheet stops at the counter top's front edge, and (x, y) is that edge under him (the hand-back's anchor, cell (50, 140)). He is the room's standing man at the bar (246 px crown to hidden feet), cut where his hands meet the counter. The plate's bottle on the counter stands in front of him at 1580; it hid only frame 2's glass, and frame 2 is not played, so he stays where the brief put him.
poseNote: Polishing a glass with a cloth, the glass in his left hand and the cloth in his right. Frames 0, 1 and 3 are played. Frame 2 (the glass set down) put the cloth and the glass in each other's hands, which the correction did not fix, so the cloth would jump from hand to hand (errata 111). It stays on the sheet as drawn, unplayed.
barksNote: NONE. He speaks when spoken to: his tree is doc 27's THE BARMAN.

sprite.frameNote: 0 polish A · 1 polish B (the glass turned, the cloth moved) · 2 here is the sheet's frame 3: he looks along the bar, the glass and cloth at his chest. He polishes slowly between 0 and 1; every few seconds a break polishes harder, and two breaks in three end with the look along the bar (tests/movement.test.mjs: a deliberate action at least every 15 s). Cut at the room's scale, so drawn 1:1.
